name: vuln-ledger
description: Dependency vulnerability and malicious-package guard with a memory for Codex: OSV checks at session start, package vetting before install, and change-only reports.

interface.shortDescription: Dependency CVE and malware guard with memory
interface.longDescription: Checks lockfiles for known vulnerabilities and malicious packages using OSV.dev, CISA KEV and EPSS, keeps a per-project ledger so each finding is reported once, stops and asks before updating anything critical, and vets new packages before install.
defaultPrompt: Use vuln-ledger to check this project's dependencies.
Does this new advisory affect this project?
Vet this package before we add it.
